title.en: A step that may not apply

t.zh: 有的步骤可做可不做：已知里有「并且」就该拆开，没有就不必。可<part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>找不到「并且」时会失败，整个证明助手随之停下。
t.en: Some steps may or may not apply: an “and” among the givens should be taken apart, and without one there is nothing to do. But <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref> fails when it finds no “and”, and the whole proof assistant stops with it.

after.zh: 可做可不做的一步，在策略语言里叫 TRY。
after.en: A step that may or may not apply is called TRY in tactic languages.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 有的目标要拆开一条已知，有的不用。
hint.en: Some goals need a given taken apart, some do not.
A region of <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref> may be left empty.
